en:
To be honest, they kinda remind me
of me back when I was a kid.

Makes me feel all warm n' fuzzy inside.
That's why I let them use my place as a hideout.

Sheesh... I put so much effort making this place
beautiful, but they just go and cramp my style.

You're different from them though, Kiryu-san.
You actually order stuff, and even pay for it.

It's a real help. You're basically
one o' my regulars at this point.

Oh yeah. I was thinking of ways I could
maybe try n' repay you for that.

And well, how 'bout I lend
a hand with the Kiryu Clan?

Haven't ya heard? I used to be legendary 'round here.
Though I've been getting kinda rusty lately.

Honestly, seeing these punks do their thing takes me
way back to how I used to be when I was young.

I'm kinda jealous that you get to be a part
of their whole shindig, Kiryu-san.

Hope I'm not too much trouble.
I'll try not to slow ya guys down.

N' I'll still be able to run the shop
even if I break all my bones. Don't worry.
This is gonna be good, leader.

Sorry, but we don't actually have
enough members yet.
Give us a little more time, then come back. Okay?
Kiryu-san! The Kiryu Clan's getting real big!

If you wanna try fighting against other clans,
talk to Joe. He said he'll help you out.

Yeah. He's pretty damn popular, so he's got
all sortsa special connections.
Try it out if you're ever feeling up to it!

I forgot to mention, Kiryu-san.
You got any interest in the black market?

Uh, guess I should explain first. It's basically a place
you can go for some... contraband merchandise.

A friend of mine's in the biz, so I thought
you might wanna meet up with him, Kiryu-san.

He's got tons of stuff great for fighting.
Probably a perfect kinda shop for you.

I was thinking you'd get some serious use outta
a place like that, so whaddya say? Want an intro?
Okay, I'll get in touch with him for you.
This is where he is. Try heading there.

I'll let you know where he's at once
he says he's cool with meeting you.

Oh! You must be Kiryu-san, huh?
The La Pente bartender told me about you.

I usually don't deal to people on our first meeting,
but I'll make an exception for friends of his.

You could say we go back a ways.
Used to get into all sortsa shit together.

By the way, I heard you've been spending
some time up in Kamurocho, too.

I've got a friend up there running a similar outfit.
I'll let him know about you if you wanna check it out.
The bartender'll message you the location.
Now then... Check out the goods.
Hey, I got some good stuff in.

Hm? You're...
Oh, you must be Kiryu-san.

I heard about you.
Got some special stuff for ya.
Hey, can you bring this to me?
I wish I had one of these...
No, this isn't what I want...
No, this isn't right at all...
Huh? Are you sure about this?
Hey, get out of the way!
Think you could bring me one of these?
If only I had one of these...
No, you got it all wrong...
I don't think I can do that.
Hmm, how about one of these?
No, you missed the mark a bit...
Hey, won't you open this for me?
No, this not what I want.
Huh? You do this for me?
I won't do it again, promise.
I'm sorry! Just please, help me...
Time for you to pay up.

Hey, don't fuck with me.
*If you don't wanna pay, I'll make you!
Hey, you're disrupting the shoot! MOVE!
You really helped me out there.
Just shut up and hand over the cash!
Hey, what're you doing with my woman!?
What was that!? I'm done with you, bastard!

If you don't wanna get hurt,
how 'bout you hand over 100k?
You're asking for it. Here comes the pain!
I'm glad you know what's up.

If you don't wanna get hurt,
how 'bout you hand over 50k?

If you don't wanna get hurt,
how 'bout you hand over a cool million?
Wish I had one o' these...
This ain't lookin' good fer us!
Wish I could get a hold o' one...
I was hopin' for one of these.
Yup yup, this is the one!
Yup yup, you're right on the money!
Yeah, this here's what I want!
Hey, can I ask ya t'open this?
Think y'could brimg me one o' these?
Huh? N' yer sure about that?

I was wondering if you could
bring me one of these.
Don't think i can do that.
Not really what I was looking for.
Hey, I hope y'can bring me one o' these.
Huh? Are ya sure about that?
Think y'could bring one o' these my way?
Hey, get yer ass back here!
Could I trouble ya for one of these?
Nah, this ain't the right one...
Where'd they go runnin' off to?
Please! I need one of these real bad!
Nah, this ain't what I'm lookin' fer.
I hope you can bring me one of these.
Here, this is how I'm thankin' ya.
Y'know, I could really use one o' these.
I'm in the clear thanks to you.
I won't do it again, promise...
Well... This lack of paper is a problem.

I'm way too hungry to even move...
You don't have any food, do you?
Well... This lack o' paper's ruinin' me.

I'm so starvin' I can barely move.
Ya got anything to eat?
Hey, yer interruptin' our shoot! Move!
I gotta get this package on its way...
How do I deal with this...?
Uh... This lack of  paper's a real mess.
I've gotta get this package delivered fast...
I'm in trouble if I don't deliver this package...

My body's not ready... Need food...
You don't have anything, do you?

Stuff gets buried with corpses all the time. Jus' so
happens that a lot of it ends up bein' pretty pricey.

Quit yer goddamn yappin'!
*I'm gonna make you pay me!
Whaddya think you're doing with my woman!?
What was that!? You're finished, asshole!

If you don't wanna get hurt,
how 'bout you hand over a nice million?
Hey, what're y'doin' with my woman!?

If y'don't wanna get yerself hurt,
yer gonna have t'gimme 100k.

If y'don't wanna get yerself hurt,
yer gonna have t'gimme 50k.

If y'don't wanna get yerself hurt,
yer gonna have t'gimme a million.

Quit yer goddamn yappin'!
I'm gonna make you pay me!
Jus' shut yer mouth n' gimme yer money!
Yo, what're y'doin' with my woman!?
Yer asking fer it. Here comes the pain!

If you don't wanna get hurt,
how 'bout you hand over a sweet million?
What are you trying to do!?

I took my eyes off him for just a second,
and he straight up disappeared...
Where did he get off to...!?

Here, this is my number. Please, please,
please let me know if you find him!

If you want to keep all your teeth aligned,
you should probably think about paying up.
Hey, this guy tried to drag me off with him!
Someone should come kick his ass!

I took my eyes off o' him fer jus' a sec,
n' he straight up disappeared...
